title: Identity & access
subtitle: Who can sign in, what they can do, and how they prove it.

seam.body: {{what}} is a declared contract — the backend endpoint is not live yet, so there is nothing to show. This panel will populate the moment it lands; it never fabricates data.

address.addressTitle: Passkeys are not available at this address.
address.ipBody: A passkey relying party has to be a domain name that this deployment's verifier accepts, and an IP address is not one. Reach this console by a host name to register or use a passkey.
address.nameBody: A passkey relying party has to be a domain name that this deployment's verifier accepts, and this host name is not one: it needs a dot, and only ASCII letters, digits and hyphens.
address.insecureTitle: This page is not a secure context.
address.insecureBody: Browsers run the passkey API only in a secure context, so no passkey can be registered or used here. Reach this console over HTTPS, or on the local host.
address.unsupportedTitle: This browser has no passkey support.
address.unsupportedBody: This browser exposes no WebAuthn API, so a passkey cannot be registered or used here. Use a browser with passkey support.
address.sameDevice: On this device the same console also answers at:

assurance.stepUpBody: {{action}} requires {{required}}. Your session is {{current}}. Use a passkey on your device or a security key to continue.
assurance.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn. A platform that supports phishing-resistant authenticators is required for privileged actions.
assurance.failed: Step-up did not complete. The action stays denied.
assurance.relyingPartyUnusable: Passkeys are not available on this deployment: the engine has no usable relying party for the address the console is served at. An operator has to configure a valid relying-party domain — a dotted host name, or localhost where that is appropriate — reach the console at that declared secure origin, and restart the engine after the change. Retrying at a different address alone will not repair it.

actions.providers: Registering or withdrawing a provider credential
actions.stepUpPolicy: Changing the extra check for administrative actions
actions.signing: Turning report signing on or off

assurance.unenrolled: No passkey is registered for your account yet. Register a passkey on your device or a security key in the Privileged login tab, then authenticate.
assurance.unenrolledInline: No passkey is registered for your account yet. Register one below.
assurance.enrollHint: Register your first passkey on this device or on a security key. Registration alone does not authenticate your session or complete the pending action.
assurance.enrollUnsupported: This browser cannot register a passkey. Use a browser with passkey support.
assurance.registered: Passkey registered. Authenticate to verify this session, then review and complete the pending action.
assurance.registrationUnknown: Registration could not be confirmed. The passkey may have been saved. Select Authenticate to check; registration will not be sent again automatically.
assurance.authenticationUnknown: Authentication could not be confirmed. Your session may already be elevated. Check the session before trying again.
assurance.needsAuthentication: An existing passkey must authenticate this session before another can be registered. Select Authenticate.
assurance.sessionExpired: This session was refused. Close this action and sign in again before retrying.
assurance.verificationFailed: The session could not be verified for this action. Authentication may have completed; the action has not continued.
assurance.cancelled: The passkey operation was dismissed or timed out. You can start a new attempt. The action has not continued.
assurance.cancelHint: Closing cancels this action. A registration or authentication already sent may still complete.
assurance.registrationUnknownElsewhere: Registration could not be confirmed. The passkey may have been saved. Close this dialog and check your passkeys before starting another registration.

code.title: Sign in with your authenticator code
code.body: {{action}} needs a sign-in with your authenticator code on this deployment. Sign in again and enter your code.

references.note: Standards this panel reflects. The panel observes and verifies; it does not claim certification.

sso.title: Single sign-on (OIDC / SAML)
sso.description: Federated login is configured in SSO / IdP, or by environment at boot. This panel documents the configuration, checks the exact redirect URI and surfaces the connection state — it does not write the configuration.
sso.notConfiguredHint: No identity provider is configured, so federation requests return 501. Set the environment keys below and restart the engine to enable SSO.
sso.redirectCheckHint: Paste the redirect/ACS URI configured in your identity provider. It must match the value above exactly (RFC 9700).
sso.redirectMatch: Exact match — this redirect URI is valid.
sso.redirectMismatch: Does not match exactly. The IdP must use the redirect URI above, character-for-character.
sso.envNote: Configuration is read once at boot from the environment; there is no configuration write API. Secrets are never read back.

scim.title: SCIM 2.0 provisioning
scim.description: Inbound provisioning of users and groups. Read-only status of the service provider, the synchronized users, and the leaver evidence.
scim.businessOnly: The inbound SCIM server requires Business. Remove a person from the organization in People.
scim.bearerNote: Authentication is a tenant-bound bearer token. The token value is never displayed — only its reference.
scim.noUsersHint: Once your IdP provisions users over SCIM they appear here. A disabled (mover/leaver) user shows as inactive.
scim.groupsSupported: Group provisioning is supported inbound (groups and memberships). Mapping a directory group to a role stays operator-only, in Identity → Groups.
scim.noLeaverHint: When a SCIM leaver (delete / prov:delete) is processed, the backend revokes the user's sessions and tokens and records it here.
scim.leaverTruncated: Newest {{n}} leaver events; there are older ones
scim.leaverTruncatedHint: There are more leaver events than shown. This card lists the most recent ones, so the events cut off are the older ones; a user missing from this list is not proof that they were never deprovisioned.

roster.label: Non-human and human identities
roster.convergenceNote: This identity converges by its external ID — the same id the observed side uses — so the access map can diff what it is PERMITTED versus what it is OBSERVED doing.

nhiRoster.title: No identities yet
nhiRoster.description: Identities appear here as agents reach resources, or when you bind an agent to an identity.

mcp.title: MCP authorization
mcp.description: Whether each MCP server's OAuth token binding was verified. Defensive posture only — the panel never proxies or replays a token.
mcp.noFindingsHint: When an OAuth-protected MCP server is discovered, its token-binding posture is recorded here.
mcp.truncatedHint: There are more MCP authorization findings than shown; this page loads a single page of rows. A server missing from this list is not proof that no finding exists for it.
mcp.prmDescription: How an OAuth-protected MCP server binds a token to one concrete resource — so a token minted for one server cannot be replayed at another.

prm.title: Protected Resource Metadata
prm.body: The server advertises its authorization servers at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728).

asDiscovery.title: Authorization server discovery
asDiscovery.body: The advertised authorization server's metadata is fetched (RFC 8414).

pkce.title: PKCE S256
pkce.body: The authorization code flow uses a S256 challenge (RFC 7636) — never plain.

resourceBound.title: Resource-bound token
resourceBound.body: The resource indicator (RFC 8707) is the canonical server URI, so the token's audience is one concrete server.

introspect.title: Read-only introspection
introspect.body: The token binding is verified by read-only introspection; the panel never calls tools or proxies the token.

mcp.noPassthrough: Token passthrough is prohibited by design: the panel observes and introspects, it never forwards or replays an MCP token.

login.statusDescription: How you signed in to this session.

policy.none: This deployment asks for no extra check before administrative actions. A system administrator can turn one on under Settings › Sign-in and security.
policy.totp: Administrative actions on this deployment ask for a sign-in with an authenticator code.
policy.passkey: Administrative actions on this deployment ask for a passkey.

login.passkeyDescription: Enroll a hardware security key or platform authenticator (WebAuthn / FIDO2) for phishing-resistant privileged login.
login.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn.

passkeys.title: Registered passkeys
passkeys.description: Manage your FIDO2/WebAuthn authenticators. Each passkey provides phishing-resistant hardware-bound login.
passkeys.registerHint: Optional. Leave it empty to name it after this device.
passkeys.registerFailed: Passkey registration failed. Your browser may not support WebAuthn, or registration was canceled.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support WebAuthn/FIDO2.
passkeys.noneHint: Register a passkey to enable phishing-resistant hardware-bound login (AAL3).
passkeys.deleteBody: Delete the passkey "{{name}}"? This is permanent. You will need another registered passkey to maintain AAL3 access.
passkeys.lastCredential: Cannot delete your only passkey. Register another one first.

sessions.title: Your sign-ins
sessions.description: Browsers and clients where you are signed in. End any session you no longer use or recognize.
sessions.noneHint: Your current and recent sign-ins appear here.
sessions.endBody: This sign-in will stop working on that browser or client. You can sign in again there later.
sessions.endAllBody: The other sign-ins listed here will end. This session stays active.
sessions.endAllFailed_one: {{count}} sign-in could not be ended. Review the list and try again.
sessions.endAllFailed_other: {{count}} sign-ins could not be ended. Review the list and try again.
sessions.pairHint: Copy this private link to the device. It expires in 10 minutes and works once.
sessions.acceptHint: Continue only if you requested this link from your own account. This device will gain access to that account.
sessions.pairInvalid: This link is missing, expired, or already used. Create another link from your sign-in settings.

totp.title: TOTP second factor
totp.description: A time-based one-time password (RFC 6238) as an additional factor on your local account. It adds to — never replaces — your passkeys.
totp.scanPrompt: Scan the QR with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then enter the code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code with the TOTP provisioning URI
totp.recoveryWarning: These recovery codes are shown only once. Store them now — each can be used a single time if you lose your device.
totp.stepUpRequired: This action needs the extra check for administrative actions this deployment requires. Complete it first.
totp.sealerUnavailable: The TOTP seed sealer is not available on this deployment; enrollment is disabled until an operator fixes it.
totp.loadFailed: The factor status could not be loaded.
totp.policyDescription: When on, administrators (superadmins and any tenant admin or owner) must enroll a factor before their password login completes.
totp.policyAal3Note: Accounts without a code are asked to set one up at their next sign-in; they are never locked out.

stepUpPolicy.title: Extra check for administrative actions
stepUpPolicy.description: Off by default. Turn it on to ask for an authenticator code or a passkey before administrative changes such as users, identity providers, secrets or tool installs.
stepUpPolicy.loadFailed: This setting could not be read. Refresh the page to try again.
stepUpPolicy.note: To require a passkey, sign in with your passkey here first. To require an authenticator code, sign in with your code first. To turn it off or lower it, pass the current check first. A change takes effect within a few seconds on every server.

refused.passkey_not_enrolled: Add a passkey to your account first (Identity > Passkeys), then turn this on.
refused.totp_sign_in_required: Set up an authenticator app and sign in with its code first, then turn this on.
